text:
Rachel (support): Heads up — got an escalated customer report from AcmeMaps: p95 latency jumped ~2-3x after yesterday's runtime rollout. They sent traces showing long stalls around attention ops. Putting root info here and tagging @Devon and @Sam.

Devon (eng-runtime): Thanks. Any customer repro or request IDs?

Rachel (support): Customer gave two example request IDs and said it happens on long contexts (~4k tokens) and with streaming. Request IDs: req-ACME-3311, req-ACME-3312. They also attached a small reproducible script (curl) they'll allow us to run against their dedicated instance.

Sam (eng-sre): I pulled infra metrics for the dedicated cluster: noticed GPU utilization unchanged but tail latency spikes on a subset of nodes. Looks correlated with the new kernel selection change that flipped FlashAttention->SDPA fallback for certain seq lengths.

Devon (eng-runtime): Right — yesterday we landed kernel-selector v2 which prefers FlashAttention kernels for many configs but falls back to SDPA for some shapes. There was also a compile flag tweak: \`-DUSE_NEW_MM=1\` baked into the latest image. Could be regressing when NVTX shows long memcpy/transpose.

Alex (eng-infra): I can repro locally using their sample. Quick repro steps I ran:

```bash
# replicate customer pattern (tokenizer + many small prompt chunks)
curl -X POST https://dedicated.acme.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"mistral-8k","input":"<repeat 4000 tokens>","stream":true,"max_tokens":512}'
```

I get p99 ~ 800ms vs baseline 250ms on same hardware with previous image.

Devon (eng-runtime): Can you capture the kernel logs? Set env: \`REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel_selector,flashattn\` and re-run. Also toggle the FlashAttention override: \`REDWOOD_FORCE_FLASHATTN=0\` and \`REDWOOD_FORCE_SDPA=1\` to force SDPA path.

Alex (eng-infra): Ran that. With \`REDWOOD_FORCE_SDPA=1\` latency drops back to ~260ms. With default (auto) it's 750-900ms. With \`REDWOOD_FORCE_FLASHATTN=1\` it's ~700ms. So the SDPA path is actually faster for this workload.

Sam (eng-sre): Interesting. So kernel-selector auto-choice is picking FlashAttention for these shapes but it's worse. Might be our cost model or microbench markers are off for long sequence streaming where KV cache reuse pattern matters.

Devon (eng-runtime): Agreed. Quick mitigation: add an emergency config to blacklist FlashAttention for that model/seq-length range and roll a hotfix that flips the selector to prefer SDPA for seq_len >= 2048 when streaming=true. We can push a guard via runtime flags without full rollback.

Rachel (support): Customer wants ETA. Can we do hotfix today? They have production traffic.

Sam (eng-sre): I can patch the runtime config in prod dedicated pools: set \`kernel_selector.prefer[\"mistral-8k\"].for_streaming = sdpa\` and push as config only (no image). That should be immediate for new sessions. I'll also attach a temporary rate-limit bypass so their queued requests can pass.

Devon (eng-runtime): We should also add telemetry: emit a dimension in traces like \`selector_chosen=flashattn|sdpa|fallback\` and token-level timing for first N tokens to check cold vs warm behavior. I'll ship a small change to the config parser; can be hot-loaded.

Sam (eng-sre): Patch rolled to the affected dedicated pool at 18:12 UTC. Monitoring now.

ops-bot: Deployment event: kernel_selector.config updated for pool dedicated-us-east-2 by sam at 2026-03-15T18:12:40Z :rocket:

Alex (eng-infra): After the config flip p95/p99 for the customer's cluster dropped back down to expected levels within two minutes. Their reported request IDs now show SDPA in traces.

Rachel (support): Customer confirmed improvement: \"latency back to normal, thanks\" :white_check_mark:. They asked why auto preference picked FlashAttention.

Devon (eng-runtime): Follow-up analysis: our kernel selector uses a microbenchmark table that weights peak throughput for large batch sizes. For streaming single-request workloads with KV reuse, effective memory access patterns favor the SDPA implementation on Ampere+ cards due to lower transpose overhead. The microbenchmarks didn't capture streaming KV cache reuse well.

Sam (eng-sre): Root cause summary I'll include in postmortem: regression triggered by kernel-selector v2 + compile flag \`-DUSE_NEW_MM=1\` that nudged cost heuristics. Selector favored FlashAttention for seq>=1024 in throughput bench but not for streaming latency.

Devon (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) revert the aggressive preference in kernel-selector (short-term) 2) extend microbench harness to include streaming+kv patterns (medium) 3) add safe default: allow per-customer kernel overrides via config (short) 4) add automated canary gating by p95/p99 (short) 5) evaluate compile flag interactions (-DUSE_NEW_MM) in isolation (medium).

Alex (eng-infra): I've pushed an immediate CI job to reproduce using our new harness. The job runs both flashattn and sdpa for seqs [512, 1024, 2048, 4096] in streaming and batch modes and records median/p95/p99.

Devon (eng-runtime): Also want a small hotfix to expose runtime toggles as env vars per-deployment: \`REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERRED\` = \"sdpa\" or \"flashattn\". That gives infra a quick lever.

Sam (eng-sre): Implemented the env override and documented it in internal runbook: 

```text
# emergency runbook excerpt
# Toggle kernel preference for a service instance
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERRED=sdpa
systemctl restart redwood-runtime
# or for k8s annotated pod spec:
# env: - name: REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFERRED value: \"sdpa\"
```

Rachel (support): Ok I've told the customer the mitigation and we set a follow-up call for tomorrow. They'll want the postmortem and timeline.

Devon (eng-runtime): I'll draft the postmortem and include microbenchmark diffs + change that introduced the compile flag and kernel-selector heuristic. Assigning to myself and Sam for investigation.

Sam (eng-sre): Timeline notes for PM:
- 17:02 UTC: kernel-selector v2 rolled to prod (image tag runtime:v2.14)
- 17:35 UTC: first customer reports of p95 regression (support ticket)
- 17:50 UTC: triage, identified correlation with selector heuristics
- 18:12 UTC: config patch to prefer SDPA for streaming applied
- 18:14 UTC: customer confirms latency resolved

Devon (eng-runtime): I'll also add a unit test in kernel-selector that simulates KV cache reuse cost function so this doesn't regress.

Alex (eng-infra): One more note: some older cards still prefer FlashAttention. We need to make selector hardware-aware (SM architecture/compute cap). Adding that as medium-term item.

Rachel (support): Great. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note summarizing root cause and the mitigation steps taken.

Sam (eng-sre): Filing incident ticket INC-2026-0422 and tagging postmortem owners.

Devon (eng-runtime): Thanks all. If anyone sees other odd tail-latency blips, please ping this thread.
